summary: Vendor invoice references legacy PO and line allocations do not match receiving records
description:
Issue summary: Vendor 'GreenLayer Logistics' submitted invoice INV-2026-409 that cites PO-2019-77 (legacy). The PO was superseded in our system by PO-2025-142 but the vendor billed against the old PO number. Impact: AP has put the invoice on hold to avoid payment to wrong cost centers; vendor has flagged overdue and is requesting payment. Estimated exposure: ~$24,800 gross.

Details: Invoice has three line items allocated to distribution centers A/B/C. Receiving records in Warehouse DB show goods received under PO-2025-142 with different line splits and a credit memo applied for distribution center B in 2025 Q4. The vendor portal shows INV-2026-409 tied to PO-2019-77. No automatic three-way match occurred.

Steps to reproduce / validate: 1) Search AP ledger for INV-2026-409 and related payment holds. 2) Cross-check PO-2019-77 and PO-2025-142 in Procurement system (ProcureOne). 3) Confirm GRNs in Warehouse DB for dates 2025-11-02..2025-11-07. 4) Review vendor portal shipment and invoice history. 5) Re-run three-way match in AP tool with manual override logging.

Relevant attachments/links: ProcureOne PO records: https://procure.redwood.internal/PO/PO-2025-142, Vendor portal thread: #vendor-greencare on Slack (link internal). AP ledger snapshot: s3://redwood-finance/ap-snapshots/2026-03-09/inv-2026-409.csv.

Requested outcome: Confirm correct PO to pay against, issue payment or partial payment where appropriate, update AP/Procurement records to avoid reoccurrence, and notify vendor of next steps.
steps_to_reproduce: Open ProcureOne and compare PO-2019-77 vs PO-2025-142
Query Warehouse DB for GRNs between 2025-11-02 and 2025-11-07
Inspect vendor portal invoice history and attachments
Attempt three-way match with manual overrides and log differences
comments: [2026-03-10] Maya Chen (Reporter): Logged after vendor escalation. Put invoice on hold in AP to prevent accidental payment. Requesting Procurement to confirm which PO the goods should map to.

[2026-03-10] Priya Nair (Procurement): Procurement confirms PO-2019-77 was superseded by PO-2025-142 in Jan 2025 after contract renewal; vendor should have been notified. Will check the vendor onboarding record to see if notification was lost.

[2026-03-11] Ravi Kumar (AP): Attempted automated match; mismatch on line-level quantities for DC-B. System flagged a credit memo (CM-2025-88) that reduced payable amount. Holding payment until reconciliation. Attaching AP export.

[2026-03-11] Liam Patel (Assignee): Performed preliminary three-way match with manual overrides for DC-A and DC-C only. Generated a partial-payment recommendation: pay $12,400 now for matched lines; hold remainder pending vendor reissue or credit memo confirmation. Sent vendor a formal request to reissue invoice referencing PO-2025-142 and to attach the CM for DC-B.

[2026-03-12] Finance Ops (Automated): Accruals adjusted to reflect partial payment recommendation; created task FIN-2026-121 for month-end reconciliation. Notifying Legal for contract trace if vendor disputes.
investigation_notes: Findings so far: 1) The vendor is billing against a legacy PO number that was superseded — root cause likely a vendor-side reference error plus a missing outbound notification in ProcureOne. 2) A previously-applied credit memo (CM-2025-88) reduced liability for DC-B but vendor invoice did not reflect that credit. 3) ProcureOne retains change history showing PO supersedure but vendor communication log is incomplete; likely a process gap in vendor notifications during contract renewals. Evidence: ProcureOne changelog (2025-01-12) and Warehouse GRNs match quantities for two of three lines. Next diagnostic steps: obtain vendor invoice attachment PDF, request vendor to reissue or provide credit memo evidence, run a full GL tie-out for Q1 accruals if payment deferred.
resolution_notes: Workaround implemented: Partial payment recommendation created and accrual updated to avoid month-end mismatch. AP will issue payment for the confirmed matched lines once manager approval is recorded in AP system. Procurement to request vendor reissue with correct PO number or attach CM-2025-88. Follow-ups: 1) ProcureOne to add an automated notification on PO supersedure (owner: Priya Nair, due 2026-04-02). 2) Finance Ops to run FIN-2026-121 month-end reconciliation. 3) Vendor onboarding doc updated to include step for verifying PO numbers on invoices (owner: Vendor Ops).
next_steps: Procurement to confirm communications history with vendor and request reissued invoice (due 2026-03-16)
AP to prepare partial payment run upon approval (expected 2026-03-13)
Finance Ops to track FIN-2026-121 and report final GL adjustment before month-end close
